items.text: Various livestock AI and visual fixes: pregnant cows no longer ping‑pong between behaviors, skateboard cows are more stable, inbred vs non‑inbred cow appearances corrected, and livestock avoidance behavior improved.

Comprehensive sheep shearing overhaul: fleece persists after server restarts, shearing no longer registers as a shot, knives now wound instead of shearing, wool payout matches author settings, timers recover after saves, wool counts as harvest and goes to backpack, fur baking runs correctly, and wild sheep now flee when you attempt to shave them.
Added new bull and cow trophy models to the large hunting trophy prefab.
Medical tool now set up with global mask support, and grenades receive mask support for proper visibility handling.
Introduced unique subsystems for water pistols and keycards, removing unnecessary holdtypes.
Respawnable fridges now assign a new "first looter" when items respawn, affecting loot tracking.
Temporarily disabled tool cupboard (TC) room occlusion checks to avoid auth issues; will be re‑enabled after networking changes.
Fixed ladder hatch functionality, improving ladder access.
Loadout system now saves and restores item positions when creating or deploying loadouts.
Shearing now uses any item that can harvest corpses instead of a separate IsShearTool flag, simplifying the mechanic.
Sheep corpses now retain the shaved state and correctly copy the pose, fixing floating‑flop visual bugs.
Added shearing material and a gameplay proof‑of‑concept for sheep shearing.
Wild cows can no longer breed, age, or produce resources, and they cannot become pregnant unless their condition is at least 60%.
Introduced crab swarms with basic behavior.
Fixed crab pathing so swarms move together, each crab getting a random speed based on swarm size.
Improved fleeing and startle mechanics for crab swarms.
Integrated moveToggle so shader‑driven crabs can idle when not moving.
Added subsystem support for megaphones and mobile phones, removing now‑unnecessary override controllers.
Implemented unique subsystems for compass, detonator, and master key items, cleaning up their hold‑type controllers.
Renamed cooked, raw, and spoiled lamb meat to "Mutton" for consistency.
Fixed boat vendor dialogue on floating cities to give the correct direction for finding the purchased boat.
Fixed pregnant cows getting stuck between follow and play states.
Animals now avoid obstacles more reliably.
Wild sheep now flee when a player attempts to shave them.
Added new bull and cow trophy models.

Overhauled sheep shearing: fleece persists after server restarts, shearing no longer counts as combat, knives wound instead of shearing, correct wool payout, timers recover after saves, wool goes to backpack, fur baking limited to fleece models, and shearing works with any harvesting item (including new material), fixing lost‑state bugs.
Renamed raw, cooked, and spoiled "Lamb" meat to "Mutton".
Wild cows no longer breed, age, or produce resources; pregnancies only possible when condition is at least 60%.
Respawnable fridges now assign a new first looter after items respawn.
Loadout items retain their positions when creating or deploying loadouts.
Grenades now support mask interactions, influencing visibility and targeting.
Added dedicated subsystems for many player tools (megaphone, mobile phone, compass, detonator, master key, water pistols, keycards), removing unnecessary holdtypes and overrides.
Boat vendor dialogue now correctly indicates the direction to the purchased boat.
Livestock interaction popup repositioned to the right side, matching plant popups and keeping the model visible.
Skateboard cow durability increased, reducing breakage during use.
Crab swarms now move together with varied speeds based on size, improving their behavior.
Water height calculations corrected, fixing NaN issues that could cause abnormal water levels.

2026-09-18.summary:
### Livestock & Wildlife
- Fixed pregnant cows getting stuck between follow and play states.
- Animals now avoid obstacles more reliably.
- Wild sheep now flee when a player attempts to shave them.
- Added new bull and cow trophy models.
- Overhauled sheep shearing: fleece persists after server restarts, shearing no longer counts as combat, knives wound instead of shearing, correct wool payout, timers recover after saves, wool goes to backpack, fur baking limited to fleece models, and shearing works with any harvesting item (including new material), fixing lost‑state bugs.
- Renamed raw, cooked, and spoiled "Lamb" meat to "Mutton".
- Wild cows no longer breed, age, or produce resources; pregnancies only possible when condition is at least 60%.

### Inventory & Loot
- Respawnable fridges now assign a new first looter after items respawn.
- Loadout items retain their positions when creating or deploying loadouts.

### Combat & Tools
- Grenades now support mask interactions, influencing visibility and targeting.
- Added dedicated subsystems for many player tools (megaphone, mobile phone, compass, detonator, master key, water pistols, keycards), removing unnecessary holdtypes and overrides.

### UI & Dialogue
- Boat vendor dialogue now correctly indicates the direction to the purchased boat.
- Livestock interaction popup repositioned to the right side, matching plant popups and keeping the model visible.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Skateboard cow durability increased, reducing breakage during use.
- Crab swarms now move together with varied speeds based on size, improving their behavior.
- Water height calculations corrected, fixing NaN issues that could cause abnormal water levels.
